purpose: Small contradiction-rich review request list. It does not create Human Confirmation or Ground Truth.

items.question: When a marketplace counter has a number and unit but no explicit sold, order, review, or item-role label, should KU2D retain its semantic type as unknown?
items.why_high_value: Prevents numeric magnitude or marketplace conventions from fabricating sales labels.

items.question: Should a visible currency amount without a current, from, range, promotional, or discount role remain unknown_display_price rather than canonical current price?
items.why_high_value: Avoids contaminating price labels when the display role or selected variant is unresolved.

items.question: Does matching a canonical product or item identity across surfaces leave selected variant identity unresolved unless explicit variant-equivalence evidence is present?
items.why_high_value: Protects price correlation from false equivalence across sizes, colors, bundles, or configurations.

items.question: Should default or recommended marketplace collection order remain display-order context and never be labelled demand or national rank without an explicit sort contract?
items.why_high_value: Prevents contextual merchandising or personalization from becoming unsupported demand Ground Truth.

items.question: When cloud access is blocked but the same technique works in a separately approved normal-network environment, should the label remain environment-boundary rather than technique failure?
items.why_high_value: Keeps execution-environment selection separate from extraction-technique validity.
